metafields.value: {"assembled": {"headline": "Assembled Cabinets — FAQ", "items": [{"q": "Do assembled cabinets arrive fully built?", "a": "Yes. Assembled cabinets ship fully constructed with doors, drawers, and soft-close hardware installed — ready to hang."}, {"q": "What is the lead time for assembled cabinets?", "a": "Most assembled lines ship within 3 weeks. Exact timing is shown on each collection."}]}, "rta": {"headline": "RTA Cabinets — FAQ", "items": [{"q": "How long does it really take to assemble one cabinet?", "a": "Budget 45 minutes or more per cabinet, depending on its size and your experience with a drill. A full kitchen is a real weekend project, not an hour of work, and we'd rather you know that going in."}, {"q": "Are the doors and drawers soft close by default, or is that an upgrade?", "a": "Standard, on every door and drawer, on every style. No upgrade needed."}, {"q": "Can I see these cabinets in person before I order?", "a": "Yes, at any of our six Connecticut showrooms: Bristol, Brookfield, New London, Newington, Orange, and Stamford. If you're not nearby, book a free virtual or in-home design consult instead."}, {"q": "Do you offer financing?", "a": "Yes. 0% APR financing through GreenSky for qualifying customers, plus our Best Price Guarantee on every order."}, {"q": "Will I receive a new cabinet if something is damaged in the box?", "a": "In most cases we'll send a replacement part, not a whole new cabinet. A cracked door gets a new door, not an entirely new cabinet."}, {"q": "Will I be reimbursed for labor or time spent repairing damaged cabinets?", "a": "We're responsible for the replacement parts. We don't reimburse labor costs a customer incurs installing or repairing them."}, {"q": "How long do I have to inspect for concealed damage after delivery?", "a": "5 days from delivery to open all cabinet and accessory boxes and check for damage or defects."}, {"q": "How can I pay for my order?", "a": "MasterCard, Visa, Discover, American Express, or GreenSky financing."}, {"q": "When will my card be charged?", "a": "At the time you place your order. Card authorization is required to submit it."}, {"q": "I don't like the finish or style once it arrives. Can I return my order?", "a": "We strongly recommend ordering door samples before you buy. Finish or style preference on its own isn't a returnable reason."}, {"q": "Do I need to be home for delivery?", "a": "Yes. Someone 18 or older must be present to accept and sign for it."}, {"q": "When will my order ship, and how long until it arrives?", "a": "RTA orders ship in 5 to 10 business days. Transit to your local freight terminal typically adds another 7 to 10 business days, depending on your location and carrier."}, {"q": "I mismeasured. Can I return a cabinet?", "a": "Yes, as long as it's unopened in its original packaging and isn't a non-returnable item. Contact us for a return authorization. Returns carry a 30% restocking fee."}]}}
